documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting

analysis.summary: For FY 2025-26, Amal Ltd reported consolidated revenue of Rs 240 crore and standalone revenue of Rs 85 crore, reflecting growth driven primarily by a 164% spike in raw material Sulphur prices. Consolidated profit before tax decreased by 14% to Rs 28 crore as increased input costs could not be fully absorbed. The company completed its Sulphur yard upgradation and is executing three capital expenditure projects while evaluating two future growth projects. Amal Ltd remains debt-free with an increased cash surplus of Rs 38 crore and recommended an increased dividend of 15%. Amal Ltd published its annual report for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, detailing strong financial and operational performance.

guidance.claim: The company is evaluating two growth projects and will determine next steps based on the external business environment.
guidance.quote: Our Company is evaluating two growth projects and will decide the next steps while keeping in focus the external business environment.

demand_outlook.claim: Both global and Indian Sulphuric acid markets are growing at approximately 3% per annum.
demand_outlook.quote: Both markets are growing at about 3% per annum.

demand_outlook.claim: Higher price realisation and capacity utilisation were the primary drivers of improved consolidated performance.
demand_outlook.quote: The main contributors were higher price realisation and capacity utilisation.

capex_expansion.claim: Amal Speciality Chemicals commissioned a new plant in 2022-23 with 300 TPD equivalent capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2022–23, ASC commissioned a new manufacturing plant with an equivalent capacity of 300 TPD of sulphuric products, strengthening the presence of our Company in its existing product portfolio.

capex_expansion.claim: The company implemented two projects to enhance steam generation and recovery.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company implemented two projects for better steam generation and recovery.

margins_costs.claim: The company is exploring measures to optimize resource utilization and maintain cost efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: The Company is exploring measures to optimise resource utilisation while ensuring cost efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: Amal is introducing operational automation to increase plant uptime, enhance safety, and reduce reliance on contract manpower.
margins_costs.quote: The Company is implementing automation of identified operations to increase plant uptime, strengthen safety and reduce reliance on contract manpower.

margins_costs.claim: Prices for Sulphur, the key raw material, fluctuate from month to month.
margins_costs.quote: The price of the key raw material Sulphur, varies from month to month.

capital_allocation.claim: The company fully repaid its debt and built up a cash surplus of ₹ 22 crore as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: It repaid its entire borrowing and generated cash surplus of ` 22 cr (as on March 31, 2025).

capital_allocation.claim: Amal wiped out its remaining carried forward loss of ₹ 14 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: It wiped out its remaining carried forward loss of ` 14 cr which at peak was ` 56 cr.

risks_headwinds.claim: Monthly raw material price volatility in Sulphur presents an operational cost headwind.
risks_headwinds.quote: The price of the key raw material Sulphur, varies from month to month.

management_commitments.claim: Management is evaluating two growth projects to expand business operations.
management_commitments.quote: Our Company is evaluating two growth projects and will decide the next steps while keeping in focus the external business environment.

management_commitments.claim: The company has two CapEx proposals worth ₹ 6 crore underway to upgrade its existing manufacturing facility.
management_commitments.quote: One, to invest in upgrading the existing manufacturing facility – two CapEx proposals of ` 6 cr are underway.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
